_description: eval/datasets/multi_turn.json -- the consolidated multi-turn conversation dataset, validated by eval/validate_datasets.py (test_multi_turn), which independently re-runs scripts.llm.scope.check() against every mid-conversation-scope-shift conversation's final turn. Shape: a dict with one top-level key 'conversations' (a list of 206 conversation objects, conversation_id prefix 'mt-'). Conversation fields: conversation_id, title, grade, topic, reference_answer, turns (list of {turn, student, expected_controller_action, expected_disclosure, note/known_issue}), evaluation_rubric, known_ambiguity, archetype (one of 9 known turn-shape archetypes, or 'other' for a rare handful of old conversations), student_level, turn_length_bucket.
